## Sumas City Council Meetings &amp; Agendas

#### ***Meeting Information***

Meetings fall on the 2nd and 4th Monday of each month, unless otherwise posted.

Written citizen input will need to be submitted prior to 4:00pm on the day of the meeting via email to mquinn@cityofsumas.com or through the drop box at City Hall.
